```artifact
Feature: Admin Functionalities for Managing Labs, Chemists, Specialities, and Doctors

  Background:
    Given the admin is logged into the system

  @VIRTUA-4.2-4
  Scenario: Admin adds a new lab
    When the admin adds a new lab with name "Lab A"
    Then the system should display "Lab A" in the list of labs

  @VIRTUA-4.2-4
  Scenario: Admin adds a new chemist
    When the admin adds a new chemist with name "Chemist X"
    Then the system should display "Chemist X" in the list of chemists

  @VIRTUA-4.2-5
  Scenario: Admin updates doctor information
    Given there is a doctor with name "Doctor Y"
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Doctor YY"
    Then the system should display "Doctor YY" in the list of doctors

  @Req-1/1
  Scenario Outline: Admin adds a new speciality
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display "<speciality_name>" in the list of specialities
    Examples:
      | speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      |
      | Dermatology     |
      | |               |  # Edge case: empty name

  @Req-1/2
  Scenario Outline: Admin views and updates an existing speciality
    Given there is a speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    When the admin updates the speciality's name to "<updated_speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display "<updated_speciality_name>" in the list of specialities
    Examples:
      | speciality_name | updated_speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      | Cardio                |
      | Dermatology     | Dermato               |
      | |               | NewSpeciality         |  # Edge case: empty original name
      | NewSpeciality   | |                     |  # Edge case: empty updated name

  @Req-1/3
  Scenario Outline: Admin deletes a speciality
    Given there is a speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    And no doctors are associated with "<speciality_name>"
    When the admin deletes the speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    Then the system should not display "<speciality_name>" in the list of specialities
    Examples:
      | speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      |
      | Dermatology     |

  @Req-1/3
  Scenario Outline: Admin attempts to delete a speciality with associated doctors
    Given there is a speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    And a doctor is associated with "<speciality_name>"
    When the admin deletes the speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display an error message "Cannot delete speciality as it has associated doctors"
    Examples:
      | speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      |
      | Dermatology     |

  @Req-2
  Scenario Outline: Admin maintains doctors and associates them with specialities
    Given there is a speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    And there is a doctor with name "<doctor_name>"
    When the admin associates "<doctor_name>" with "<speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display "<doctor_name>" associated with "<speciality_name>"
    Examples:
      | speciality_name | doctor_name |
      | Cardiology      | Doctor A    |
      | Dermatology     | Doctor B    |
```
